title: Why Train Tracks Are Filled With Sharp Stones (Hindi audio, English captions)
sources: Wikipedia, 'Track ballast' - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Track_ballast (bears the load, holds the track in place, drainage, keeps down vegetation, stones must be irregular with sharp edges to interlock)

ScienceDirect Topics, 'Ballast Layer' - https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/engineering/ballast-layer (transmits train load to the ground at an acceptable level, resists sleeper movement, drainage, suppresses vegetation, hard irregular crushed rock)

Mental Floss, 'Why Are Train Tracks Built on Rocks?' - https://www.mentalfloss.com/transportation/trains/why-train-tracks-are-built-on-rocks (spreads pressure and weight, drains rainwater, discourages vegetation, smooth stones would slip and slide)

Futura Sciences, 'Those Stones Have a Name: Ballast' - https://www.futura-sciences.com/en/why-are-railroad-tracks-covered-in-crushed-stone-the-answer-is-smarter-than-it-looks_35457/ (wider load area, supports the ties that hold the rails, drainage, harder for plants to grow, angular crushed rock rather than smooth pebbles)

lines.text: हर सफ़र में दिखते हैं, पर पटरी के नीचे इतने पत्थर क्यों?
lines.caps: seen on every *trip | but why all these *stones?

lines.text: भारी ट्रेन का वज़न ये पत्थर ज़मीन के बड़े हिस्से में बाँट देते हैं।
lines.caps: they *spread the heavy *weight | over a wider *area

lines.text: ये पटरी के नीचे लगे स्लीपर को भी अपनी जगह पर टिकाए रखते हैं।
lines.caps: they also hold | the *sleepers under the rails | in *place

lines.text: बारिश का पानी इनके बीच से बह जाता है, और घास भी कम उगती है।
पर असली कमाल ये है: ये पत्थर जानबूझकर नुकीले रखे जाते हैं!
lines.caps: the big surprise: | they are *sharp | on *purpose!

lines.text: नुकीले कोने आपस में फँस जाते हैं, जबकि गोल पत्थर आसानी से फिसल जाते।
lines.caps: sharp edges *lock together | round stones would *slide

lines.text: क्या आपको ये राज़ पहले से पता था? हाँ या ना?
